title: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not verify that a referenced media item belongs to the user,…
description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.13.0 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify ownership or attachment status of media items before re-linking them. This flaw allows users with minimal privileges, such as Subscribers, to take control of and delete media uploaded by other users, including administrators.
